meta.name: facebook-ads-skill
meta.description: Master Facebook Ads for maximum ROI with precise targeting and data-driven optimization. Use for campaign structure and objectives, audience targeting (core/custom/lookalike), persona development, ad creative and copywriting, ad formats (image/video/carousel), placement optimization, pixel implementation, conversion tracking, budget allocation, A/B testing, ROAS/CPA/CTR/CPM analysis, retargeting funnels, scaling strategies, competitor research, creative variant testing, and troubleshooting underperforming campaigns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 精准定位受众，优化广告投放提高回报率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你在管理Facebook广告，想让每分预算都花得更值。
copy.tagline_en: Target audiences precisely and optimize Facebook ads for better ROI.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Facebook ads and want every dollar to work harder.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按该技能提供 Facebook 广告的策略和方法指导：设计广告活动结构、选择目标、定位受众、写文案与创意、分析数据并优化，还会给出命名规范、A/B 测试、再营销等建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Facebook 广告，或要求搭建广告活动、定位受众等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭建一个 Facebook 转化广告活动，包含命名和广告组结构。
say.note: 会按技能中的层级与命名规范给出方案。

say.text: 写 3 条针对房产客户的广告文案，使用问题式开头。
say.note: 会套用 PAS 或 AIDA 公式。

say.text: 我的广告 ROAS 只有 1.2，帮我排查可能的原因。
say.note: 会按技能中的诊断思路给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude will provide Facebook Ads guidance from this skill: campaign structure, objectives, audience targeting, ad copy, and performance analysis, plus naming conventions and testing tips.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Facebook Ads, or asks to set up a campaign, target audiences, etc.

say_en.text: Help me set up a Facebook conversion campaign with naming and ad set structure.
say_en.note: Uses the skill's hierarchy and naming conventions.

say_en.text: Write 3 ad copies for real-estate clients using a problem hook.
My ROAS is only 1.2. Help me troubleshoot possible causes.
